blocks.text: How to Plan Your Weekend Open House Route in Abbotsford

parts.t: Every listing displayed at the top of this page is an active MLS® property in the City of Abbotsford with a scheduled public open house, updated automatically as listing brokerages post Saturday and Sunday viewing windows (typically between 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM). Because Abbotsford spans 375 square kilometres from Aldergrove/Aberdeen in the west to Sumas Prairie in the east, grouping your open house stops by Highway 1 exit saves significant drive time.

A practical weekend route groups viewings into three clusters: (1) Abbotsford West via Exit 83 (Mount Lehman Road / Highstreet) and Exit 87 (Clearbrook Road) for Westerleigh townhomes, Clearbrook condos, and Townline Hill houses; (2) Central Abbotsford and Poplar via Exit 87 and Exit 90 (McCallum Road) for Mill Lake condos, Historic Downtown buildings, and UFV UDistrict developments; and (3) Abbotsford East via Exit 92 (Sumas Way) and Exit 95 (Whatcom Road) for McMillan, Old Clayburn, Eagle Mountain, McKee Peak, and Sumas Mountain homes.

blocks.text: Why Have Your Own Realtor When Visiting Abbotsford Open Houses

parts.t: When you walk into a public open house in British Columbia, the hosting agent on site represents the seller—not you—under BCFSA agency rules. blocks.text: 7 Common Questions About Abbotsford Open Houses

parts.t: When are most public open houses held in Abbotsford?

Most public open houses in Abbotsford take place on Saturdays and Sundays between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM (or 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM), with listing Realtors generally posting confirmed weekend schedules to the MLS® by Thursday afternoon.
Do I need to pre-register to attend a public open house on this page?

No appointment is required to walk through a public open house during its posted hours. However, if a scheduled time does not fit your calendar—or if a listing you want to see has no open house posted—call or text 604-928-1361 to book a private showing.
Who does the hosting Realtor represent at an Abbotsford open house?

Under British Columbia Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) rules, the agent hosting an open house represents the seller exclusively. Having your own buyer's agent ensures you receive independent comparable-sales analysis, strata document reviews, and negotiation representation at no direct commission cost to you as a buyer.
Which Abbotsford neighbourhoods have the most weekend open houses?

The highest volume of weekend open houses occurs in new and recent strata developments around Westerleigh/Highstreet (Abbotsford West), the UDistrict and Mill Lake (Central Abbotsford), and Whatcom Road, McKee, and Eagle Mountain (Abbotsford East).
Are rural farms and high-end estates usually shown by open house?

Rarely. Working ALR farms in Sumas Prairie, Matsqui, Bradner, and Aberdeen—as well as custom hillside estates over $2M on Eagle Mountain and Sumas Mountain—almost always require a pre-scheduled private appointment.
What should I ask or look for during a 15-minute open house walkthrough?

Check natural light orientation, road or flight-path noise with windows open, roof and window age, heating/cooling system type (heat pump vs baseboard), parking stall layout, and—for houses—whether any basement suite has municipal permits.
How can I get strata documents or sold comparables for an open house I visited?

Text the property address to Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca right after your walkthrough and I will send over the recent sold comparables, title/zoning notes, and available strata or disclosure documents.
